findings.name: Authenticated and anonymous responses are identical
findings.evidence: GET http://localhost:9999 returned byte-identical bodies for authenticated and anonymous sessions (sha256 prefix 8f857ffda18871bf). The target may not be honoring the supplied credentials, or the page is intentionally public — auth-required modules may produce false negatives.
findings.remediation: Verify --auth-form / --cookie credentials by browsing the target manually with the same auth shape, or pick a target URL that gates content behind authentication.

findings.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.remediation: Add Content-Security-Policy header restricting allowed sources.

findings.name: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN to prevent clickjacking.

findings.name: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' missing HttpOnly
findings.remediation: Mark cookie HttpOnly to block JavaScript access.

findings.name: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' missing SameSite
findings.remediation: Set SameSite=Strict or Lax to mitigate CSRF.

findings.name: Error-based SQL injection
findings.evidence: 'you have an error in your sql syntax' found in response body for payload "'"
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements; never concatenate user input into SQL.

findings.name: Reflected XSS
findings.evidence: payload reflected unescaped in response body
findings.remediation: Encode user-supplied output (e.g., htmlspecialchars / framework auto-escape).

findings.name: Admin-shape page reachable: /admin/
findings.remediation: Add an admin role check on /admin/.

findings.name: No lockout detected after 6 wrong-password attempts
findings.evidence: 6 sequential POSTs with synthesized wrong passwords (1s apart) returned identical (status, body sha256).
findings.remediation: Implement account lockout, rate limiting, or progressive delays after repeated failures.

findings.name: CSRF accepted without token — POST http://localhost:9999/csrf-broken
findings.remediation: Add CSRF token validation to POST endpoint.

findings.name: Login response differs for known vs unknown username
findings.evidence: Probed as user='admin' (real) and a synthesized unknown user; differing axes: status (200 vs 401), final URL (http://localhost:9999/ vs http://localhost:9999/login), body sha256, error text ('<!DOCTYPE html>' vs 'Unknown user'). real user → HTTP 200 '<!DOCTYPE html>'; unknown user → HTTP 401 'Unknown user'.
findings.remediation: Return identical response shape regardless of whether the username exists; both should fail with a generic 'Invalid credentials' message.

findings.name: Stack trace leakage on http://localhost:9999/search?q='
findings.evidence: Pattern 'Traceback (most recent call last):' found in response body. First 200 chars of leak: Traceback (most recent call last):   File "/app/views/search.py", line 42, in search     cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM items WHERE name = '{q}'")   File "/usr/lib/python3.11/sqlite3/dbapi2.py", line
findings.remediation: Configure framework to suppress stack traces in production; route exceptions to a generic error page.

findings.name: IDOR — primary user can read baseline-owned resource
findings.evidence: Primary GET sha256=3ee17fd9823e2753 == baseline GET sha256=3ee17fd9823e2753, both HTTP 200
findings.remediation: Add ownership check on idor.

findings.name: IDOR — primary user can read baseline-owned resource
findings.evidence: Primary GET sha256=7ffd061b3f24db49 == baseline GET sha256=7ffd061b3f24db49, both HTTP 200
findings.remediation: Add ownership check on id.

findings.name: Session cookie still valid after logout
findings.evidence: Authed page rendered identically before and after a logout request: pre-logout 200/7ffd061b, post-logout 200/7ffd061b — body sha256 IDENTICAL.
findings.remediation: Invalidate session server-side on logout (call session.clear() / session.invalidate() / equivalent); do not rely on client-side cookie deletion alone.

findings.name: Session ID not regenerated on login
findings.evidence: Pre-login cookie PHPSESSID=pK-mUVdq; post-login cookie PHPSESSID=pK-mUVdq; identical.
findings.remediation: Regenerate session ID on authentication state transition (login/logout). Most frameworks have a session.regenerate() / session.regenerate_id() helper.
